summary: Empty-pipeline what_next ranks release standing-track repair (#814/#320) when release-major/minor/patch are missing (legacy drift) ahead of SPEC/PM/epic work; live get_what_next loads get_release_status when no open PRs.

migration_guidance: 2. On priority=release_repair: gh plate release status then gh plate release repair (dry-run) and --apply when safe.
3. Re-run what-next; mode should become multi-track when tracks exist.
